title: Product
description: Schema for a product in the customer service catalogue

aliases.description: Alternative names or keywords used by customers to refer to this product

price.description: Price of the product. Null if unknown or not set.

currency.description: Currency code (e.g. VND, USD). Null if price is null.

material.description: Material of the product (e.g. Bạc S925, Vàng 18k). Null if unknown.

variants.description: Available variants (sizes, colors). Null if none.

in_stock.description: Stock status. True if in stock, False if pre-order/out of stock, null if unknown.

ship_note.description: Specific shipping instructions or delivery timeline for this item.

size_guide.description: Size measurement instructions or size chart link.
